name: Kirk Hill Wind Farm API
description:
The API exposes read-only wind farm data. Generation, indicative carbon avoided, and capacity-factor values default to the API key holder's share of the wind farm, with `scope=site` available for whole-site data. It does not expose owner, account, login, password, Watts owned, or ownership percentage data. All timestamps in responses are UTC ISO-8601 strings.

API requests are rate limited per account (120 requests per minute by default, shared across all of an account's API keys). Exceeding the limit returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header. Per-account limits can be adjusted or lifted by an administrator.
